driver: STM32N6 CRC calculation unit (CRC) HAL driver (on the verified CRC LL driver)

source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 26 (CRC) + memory map p.176
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.26 CRC register interface + memory map p.176 (CRC secure base 0x56024C00)
target.safety_allocation: NOT_PROVIDED: no owner safety scope recorded for the CRC work orders

scope: HAL: hal_status_t API with HAL_CRC_ prefix and a const configuration pointer, built only on the PROVIDED LL_CRC_ functions
Initialise the calculation unit from a configuration (polynomial, polynomial size, initial value, input and output reversal), then reset the calculation unit (RM0486 26.3)
Calculate the CRC of a buffer of 32-bit words: reset the calculation unit, feed the words, write the CRC to the caller's result
Accumulate: feed further 32-bit words onto the current CRC without a reset and write the CRC to the caller's result

Parameter checks before any register write, returning HAL_ERROR: NULL configuration, buffer or result pointer, a word count of 0, a polynomial size or reversal value outside its field, an even polynomial (not supported, RM0486 26.3.3)
No HAL_CRC_ function waits on a CRC flag (a fed word is computed within 4 AHB clock cycles, RM0486 26.3.3)

Performance: each HAL_CRC_ call completes within the simulation performance budget for buffers of at most 64 words (HAL_CRC_Calculate/HAL_CRC_Accumulate count <= 64); larger buffers are outside the per-call budget
The LL header is provided by a verified CRC LL work order (--provided-from)
Out of scope: 8-bit and 16-bit data register accesses, DMA, interrupts, low-power modes, the independent data register in the HAL API
